claims.object_text: four phenotypic domains controlled by Syngap1 expression across vertebrate species
claims.quote: Here, we describe four phenotypic domains that are controlled by Syngap1 expression across vertebrate species.
Two additional domains are defined by integrating the current literature with new data indicating that SYNGAP1/Syngap1 regulates innate survival behaviors and brain structure.
